title: scikit-learn changelog gate fails: PR touches tests with no towncrier entry

inputs.failed_job_name: A reviewer will let you know if it is required or can be bypassed

ground_truth.fix_summary: Add a towncrier changelog fragment under doc/whats_new/upcoming_changes/ for the modules this PR touches, or have a maintainer set the bypass label.

provenance.notes: Labelled code_change/lint_or_format because the gate reads the contents of the change and finds a required artefact missing: 'No changelog file was added in the correct directories for PR 34137, looked in 45 directories'. related_to_diff is true because the preceding step matched the changed file list against sklearn/.+test_.+py and only then enabled the check. The trailing 'exit 1' step is a deliberate instruction printer, so the failure is policy, not a broken pipeline, which is why this is not pipeline_config. culprit_files is empty because the fix is a new file that does not exist yet and the log names no existing file at fault. Note that snapshot.json records pr_number as null while the log names PR 34137; the inputs keep the snapshot value.
